disposition: Three inherited normal-mapped primitives omit tangent attributes. Runtime-generated tangent-space portability remains a known baseline limitation, not a new Jinri defect or a warning-free whole-campus claim. UNUSED_OBJECT and IMAGE_NPOT_DIMENSIONS are informational.
